Exercise 4: Content Strategy Decisions

28 points
Choose the best approach for each content strategy challenge.
Scenario 1 7 points

Your team produces 20 blog posts per month, but engagement is flat. Most posts are "5 Tips" style listicles. What's the 10x content move?

Increase to 30 posts per month to get more visibility
Improve SEO keywords in the existing listicles
Automate listicles with AI, reallocate human time to fewer, deeply specific pieces with original stories
Add more graphics and formatting to make posts more visually appealing
Scenario 2 7 points

You ask Claude to recommend data platform vendors for supply chain analytics. Your company doesn't appear in the response. What's the most likely cause?

Claude has a bias against your company
Your public content is too generic or vague to be cited for specific use case queries
Your website needs better traditional SEO
You need to pay for AI search placement
Scenario 3 7 points

Your best content person is spending 60% of their time on weekly social posts and email newsletters. What's the fix?

Hire another person to share the social/email load
Build an AI pipeline for commodity content so they can focus on signature pieces that only they can write
Reduce social posting frequency to free up time
Outsource social media to an agency
Scenario 4 7 points

An analyst quotes your PMM's framework in their report. Your VP asks how to measure content success now. What metric matters most?

Blog post views per month
Social media follower growth
Influence metrics: analyst citations, prospect references in sales calls, deal impact
Number of content assets produced per quarter
